يعتطفن (form VIII)
# يَعْتَطِفْنَ (yaʕtaṭifna) /jaʕ.ta.tˤif.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# يُعْتَطَفْنَ (yuʕtaṭafna) /juʕ.ta.tˤaf.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
